rule: each case: evaluate the research-side G1 items of the protocol on `robustness` with `other_registered_candidates` added to the DSR trial count; results must equal `expected` exactly (PASS | FAIL | N/A); an optional case field `trials_floor` (default 0) is the trial-count floor passed to the DSR item (max with dsr_inputs.trials); 1.6 also needs dsr_inputs.daily_returns (V[SR] floor recomputed with the statistics module) and 1.13 needs rating.facts.synthetic_view (protocol v2). Protocol 2.2 (research review 2026-10-11) adds: `robustness.service_runs.service_conservative_net` (the research service's conservative-fill net of the base IR; 1.3-1.5 need both the local net and the service-side net to exceed the threshold; for 1.4 / 1.5 the service-side net is adjusted by the local stress delta (stressed local net - base local net); missing = FAIL), and two optional case fields that AlphaKeel computes itself instead of reading the researcher's report: `filter_required_by_ir` (default false; the IR restricts its universe, so 1.12 fails when filter_tested is false) and `ak_synthetic` (default null; true = the IS pack data lock has no scans, i.e. a dataset pack: 1.13 caps the grade at B whatever synthetic_view says). Protocol 2.1+: each entry of `ir_cases` evaluates the AlphaKeel-side G1 items on a Strategy IR `ir` and the universe facts `pack_universe` of the robustness IS pack ({selection, top_n, survivorship}, or null = unknown): `expected` holds 1.18 and 1.19 (PASS | FAIL), `robust_width` (PASS | FAIL: the robust interval of every parameter deviates from its value by at least 20% on EACH side, (value-lo) >= 0.2|value| and (hi-value) >= 0.2|value|; value 0 needs hi-lo >= 0.2 x the allowed range width: 0.001 for funding_hourly_net, 1 for funding_apr / price_estimated, 0.01 for the other rate features / basis_stress, 1e6 for volume_min, 60000 for the millisecond features, 1440 for cooldown_minutes; unknown position = FAIL) and `grade_cap` (always null since 2.2). 1.18 (2.2): screener_live -> PASS; pit_membership with survivorship includes_delisted* -> PASS; anything with a survivors side (survivors_*, partial_from_archive) or declared -> FAIL; missing annotation -> FAIL. 1.19 (2.2): every numeric literal of the entry/exit expressions (entry/exit conditions' values, entry.candidate_limit, entry.cooldown_minutes, exit.max_hold_hours, exit.max_loss, exit.take_profit) is a declared parameter's path, a structural constant by POSITION (a condition's compare value 0; the compare value 1 of price_estimated; entry.cooldown_minutes 0), or listed in provenance.fixed_literals with an equal value; a listed path that is no literal also fails. Protocol 2.3: `ir_universe` (optional case field) replaces `filter_required_by_ir` -- the flag is DERIVED from it by `ir_filter_required` (excluded_bases non-empty, or any bases allow-list); the top-level `derivations` section lists the inputs and expected values of the two derivation functions (`ir_filter_required`, `pack_is_synthetic`) so both sides test the functions themselves, not only the flags. Protocol 2.5: 1.9 also needs a lo AND a hi neighbour for every parameter named in robustness.parameters.ranges / neighbours / skipped (a missing side = FAIL); when the filter was tested, 1.12 also needs robustness.filter.permutation.draws >= min_permutations (999) and robustness.filter.permutation.seed = the first 8 bytes (big-endian unsigned) of SHA-256(robustness.strategy_id) (else FAIL). Protocol 3.0: 1.2 counts `robustness.rating.facts.entries_distinct` (closed entries plus entries still open at the window end held >= 7 days), NOT `trades_closed`; a missing `entries_distinct` = FAIL, never a fallback to `trades_closed`.

cases.name: all_pass
cases.why: every research-side item passes; no filter under test -> 1.12 not applicable

cases.name: boundaries
cases.why: inclusive bounds pass (30 trades, PBO 0.20 with 8 variants, share 0.50, p 0.05); strict bounds fail at equality (net 0, CI lower 0); a missing basis stress, missing dsr_inputs, no neighbours, a 29-day fold fail

cases.name: not_applicable_and_missing
cases.why: PBO with 7 variants is not applicable; a filter under test without a p-value fails; walk-forward not computable fails; one negative neighbour fails; a null top-coin share fails; DSR with 7 + 23 trials = 0.852 fails

walk_forward.reason: IS window too short for 3 folds of 30 days

cases.name: dsr_inconsistent
cases.why: the reported DSR differs from the one recomputed from dsr_inputs with the battery's own trial count by more than 1e-6: the inputs are not trusted

cases.name: walk_forward_one_of_three
cases.why: only 1 of 3 folds positive (a zero net is not positive) fails even with efficiency exactly 0.5

cases.name: walk_forward_efficiency_boundary
cases.why: 2 of 3 positive folds and efficiency exactly 0.5 pass

cases.name: grade_a
cases.why: A is better than B

cases.name: trials_floor_raises_the_count
cases.why: a trials floor of 200 (IR provenance.trials.count + battery candidates, or the research-service ledger) deflates the DSR below 0.95

cases.name: trials_floor_below_battery_is_ignored
cases.why: a floor below dsr_inputs.trials changes nothing (the count is the max)

cases.name: var_sr_below_floor
cases.why: a self-reported V[SR] below the floor recomputed from daily_returns fails even though the reported DSR is consistent with it

cases.name: daily_returns_missing
cases.why: without daily_returns the V[SR] floor cannot be recomputed

cases.name: synthetic_cap_violated
cases.why: synthetic_view = true with grade A: the cap at B is violated

cases.name: synthetic_view_missing
cases.why: rating.facts.synthetic_view absent: the cap cannot be checked

cases.name: synthetic_by_data_view
cases.why: synthetic_view false but data_view.view is the dataset view: still capped at B

cases.name: synthetic_grade_b_passes
cases.why: a synthetic view rated B is within the cap

cases.name: service_net_negative
cases.why: the service-side conservative net is negative while the local one-level-fill net is positive: 1.3-1.5 fail

cases.name: service_net_missing
cases.why: no service-side conservative net (not registered / not verified): the local figure alone does not count

cases.name: service_net_small_fails_the_stress_adjustment
cases.why: service net 30 passes 1.3 but the stressed local deltas (98.1-152.3, 120.0-152.3) push 1.4 down, 1.5 stays positive

cases.name: filter_forced_by_ir_not_tested
cases.why: the IR restricts its universe (excluded_bases) but filter_tested is false: 1.12 fails

cases.name: filter_forced_by_bases_whitelist
cases.why: the IR gives a bases allow-list (no excluded_bases): the filter is restricted by the IR whatever the battery traded, so filter_tested false fails 1.12 (protocol 2.3; the derivation is `ir_filter_required` on `ir_universe`)

cases.name: filter_forced_by_ir_tested
cases.why: the IR restricts its universe and the filter was permutation-tested with p 0.01: 1.12 passes

cases.name: synthetic_by_data_lock
cases.why: grade A with synthetic_view false and no data_view, but the IS pack data lock has no scans (dataset pack): AlphaKeel caps at B, A fails

cases.name: synthetic_by_data_lock_grade_b
cases.why: a dataset pack rated B is within the cap

cases.name: neighbour_hi_missing
cases.why: protocol 2.5 (D4-10): parameter min_net has only its lo neighbour -> 1.9 FAIL

cases.name: permutations_too_few
cases.why: protocol 2.5 (D4-5): 30 permutation draws < min_permutations 999 -> 1.12 FAIL

cases.name: permutation_seed_foreign
cases.why: protocol 2.5 (D4-5): the battery used seed 7, not the seed AlphaKeel derives from the strategy id -> 1.12 FAIL

cases.name: entries_distinct_not_trades_closed
cases.why: protocol 3.0: 1.2 counts entries_distinct (31 >= 30), not trades_closed (25)

cases.name: trades_closed_not_entries_distinct
cases.why: protocol 3.0: 1.2 counts entries_distinct (25 < 30) even though trades_closed is 31

cases.name: entries_distinct_missing
cases.why: protocol 3.0: robustness without rating.facts.entries_distinct fails 1.2 (no fallback to trades_closed)

ir_cases.name: clear
ir_cases.why: point-in-time universe with delisted contracts, every literal declared or listed, wide robust range

ir_cases.name: archive_delisted_passes
ir_cases.why: includes_delisted_from_archive still counts as excluding survivor bias

ir_cases.name: declared_survivors
ir_cases.why: a declared list on a survivors-only universe fails 1.18

ir_cases.name: declared_survivors_before_first_seen
ir_cases.why: survivors_before_first_seen is a survivors_* annotation too

ir_cases.name: pit_survivor_side_caps_c
ir_cases.why: pit_membership but one side only has survivors: fails (protocol 2.2; 2.1 passed it with a grade cap of C, which could never pass 1.13 min B)

ir_cases.name: declared_includes_delisted_caps_c
ir_cases.why: declared list over a universe that includes delisted contracts: fails (protocol 2.2: only a point-in-time selection or a scan pack passes)

ir_cases.name: scan_pack_passes
ir_cases.why: scan packs (screener_live) saw the then-listed contracts: pass, no cap

ir_cases.name: old_pack_without_annotation
ir_cases.why: a pack whose data lock has no universe.selection fails: re-pack

ir_cases.name: pack_unknown
ir_cases.why: no universe facts for the IS pack fail 1.18

ir_cases.name: selection_without_survivorship
ir_cases.why: a selection without survivorship fails 1.18

ir_cases.name: literal_unlisted
ir_cases.why: candidate_limit / cooldown / max_hold / max_loss are neither parameters, exempt nor listed

ir_cases.name: literal_value_mismatch
ir_cases.why: a listed value that differs from the IR fails

ir_cases.name: literal_stale_path
ir_cases.why: a listed path that points at no literal fails

ir_cases.name: literal_exemptions
ir_cases.why: exemptions are by POSITION: a condition compare value 0 and entry.cooldown_minutes 0 need no declaration (the other literals are listed)

ir_cases.name: literal_next_to_exempt
ir_cases.why: 59 is not 0: an unlisted cooldown fails (and 24 / 60 / 1000 / 3600 are no longer exempt by value)

ir_cases.name: sizing_and_assumptions_are_not_expressions
ir_cases.why: sizing and assumptions literals are not entry/exit expressions

ir_cases.name: robust_width_exactly_twenty_percent
ir_cases.why: (hi-lo)/(2|value|) = 0.2 exactly passes

ir_cases.name: robust_width_just_below
ir_cases.why: a hair under 20% fails (the neighbour test would test nothing)

ir_cases.name: robust_width_asymmetric_wide_enough
ir_cases.why: asymmetric but each side is at least 20% away from the value 0.0005 (low side exactly 0.2, high side 0.24): PASS under the per-side rule (protocol 2.2+, the same rule in AlphaKeel and in the VT precheck)

ir_cases.name: robust_width_zero_value_wide
ir_cases.why: value 0: hi-lo must be at least 0.2 x the allowed range width (0.01 for a net-rate feature, i.e. 0.002)

ir_cases.name: robust_width_zero_value_narrow
ir_cases.why: value 0 with hi-lo = 0.001 < 0.002 fails

ir_cases.name: pit_partial_from_archive_fails
ir_cases.why: the archive discovery was partial (skipped or failed candidates, or the window starts before the archive): partial_from_archive counts like survivors_*

ir_cases.name: literal_max_hold_24_not_exempt
ir_cases.why: max_hold_hours = 24 was exempt by value before 2.2; it now has to be declared or listed

ir_cases.name: literal_cooldown_60_not_exempt
ir_cases.why: cooldown_minutes = 60 is not exempt by position (only 0 is)

ir_cases.name: literal_volume_1000_not_exempt
ir_cases.why: a volume_min / compare value 1000 is not exempt by value

ir_cases.name: robust_width_one_side_narrow
ir_cases.why: [0.0005, 0.0007] around 0.0005 has a total relative half width of 0.2 (passed before protocol 2.2) but the low side deviates by 0: each side must be at least 20%

derivations.why: AlphaKeel derives these flags itself (never from the researcher's report); both sides must derive the same value from the same inputs (protocol 2.3).
